share.text: Both numbers are about love and closeness (11/2, 6). The theme is doubled, and neither number sets a limit.

course.about: 6 and 11/2 together in the emotion center
course.text: "Even with an unbalanced number (such as 11/2) along with the number 6 in the emotion center, you will find that you have a relatively good sex life, because the number 6 is so good to have in a center."

reasoning: 11/2 is the main one, so the trouble is real: feelings run too high and they lean on a partner (11/2). The 6 softens that. It does not remove it.
The same two numbers the other way round (6 colored by 11/2) is a loving person who gives too much. This one is an overwhelmed person (11/2) who is still easy to love (6).
People want to be close to them (6), and they cannot tell who is safe to let in (11/2).
They calm strong feelings (11/2) with comfort: food, shopping, making the home nice (6).
name.solar=11|name.solarExtra=6.best: Feels what a loved one is going through (11/2) and makes them feel at home (6).
name.solar=11|name.solarExtra=6.worst: Gives in to a partner every time (11/2) to keep the home peaceful (6).

name.lowerRight=8|name.solar=15.position: Inside they run on attraction: charm, desire and wanting to be wanted (15/6). What a partner and family see is someone strong and careful, who keeps watch over them and keeps a little distance (8).

share.title: What Sets Them Apart
share.text: 15/6 reaches for people and has few boundaries (15/6). 8 keeps a ring around itself and lets nobody too close (8).

course.about: 15/6 in the emotion center with an 8 beside it, when out of balance; then the combo guide on the same pair in better balance
course.text: "15/6 and 8 can give psychopathic tendencies where you coolly are able to exploit other people." In better balance: "good at seeing through others (15/6), but may use this to their own advantage".

reasoning: A love life aura is meant to shield the emotion center. This one does: the family sees composure (8), not the craving under it (15/6).
They sense exactly what a partner wants (15/6), and they remember everything a partner ever did (8).
They want to be desired (15/6) and do not let a partner close enough to hurt them (8). The partner feels wanted and shut out at once.
They are drawn to temptation themselves (15/6) and demand loyalty (8), so they watch a partner for the very thing they feel pulled toward.
name.lowerRight=8|name.solar=15.best: Strongly attracted to a partner (15/6) and loyal and protective toward them (8).
name.lowerRight=8|name.solar=15.worst: Uses what a partner longs for (15/6) to keep control of them (8).

name.lowerLeft=9|name.solar=15.position: Inside they run on attraction: charm, desire and wanting to be wanted (15/6). What colleagues and acquaintances see is someone strong-willed, direct and tough on themselves (9).

share.title: What Sets Them Apart
share.text: 15/6 pulls people toward them (15/6). 9 goes straight at a thing and wants nobody leaning on them (9).

course.about: 15/6 with a 9 beside it in a center; the course calls this pair "The Player"
course.text: "it can give a very large and strong charisma, but it also tends to make you not shy away from manipulating other people to get things your way."

reasoning: Colleagues meet a blunt, capable person (9) and do not guess how much that person wants to be liked (15/6).
At work they turn the charm on (15/6) to get a thing done fast (9).
The combo guide on this pair: they seek attention (15/6) and get angry when someone else takes it (9). Among colleagues that shows as rivalry.
Their moods swing inside (15/6). In front of colleagues they hold it down (9), and when pushed too far it comes out as an angry outburst (9).
name.lowerLeft=9|name.solar=15.best: Senses what each colleague wants (15/6) and uses it to get the best out of them (9).
name.lowerLeft=9|name.solar=15.worst: Charms a colleague to get their way (15/6) and turns harsh when it does not work (9).
